cases.requirement: Make the transfer limit configurable per merchant. AC-01: Given a payout amount equal to the merchant's limit, When the payout is submitted, Then it is accepted. AC-02: Given a payout amount above the merchant's limit, When the payout is submitted, Then CheckLimit returns ErrLimitExceeded.

AC-01: Given an authenticated customer who owns account X, When they request X's statement for a month, Then the statement is returned. Customers may read only their own accounts, as on every other account endpoint.

context_slices.note: GetTransactions and CloseAccount in the same file use the same caller/OwnerID check.

context_slices.code: r.Get("/accounts/{id}/statement", h.GetStatement) // authenticated customer route, no per-account middleware

cases.requirement: AC-01: Given a transient bank error (timeout or 503), When a transfer is submitted, Then the submission is retried up to 3 attempts in total. AC-02: One Transfer.ID never creates more than one bank transfer.

AC-01: Given a refund whose ledger credit succeeds, When it completes, Then the refund_completed metric is incremented. Existing behaviour stays: a ledger credit failure returns an error and the refund is not COMPLETED.
AC-01: Given a completed payout with a bank reference, When GET /payouts/{id} is called, Then the response includes bank_reference. Payouts without a reference omit the field.
Rename the metric fx_quote_requests to fx_quote_requests_total. No behaviour change. The dashboard and alert already query the new name.
Readability cleanup: rename the local accumulator in SumEntries. No behaviour change.

AC-01: Given a daily or monthly report with at least one payout, When the summary is built, Then AverageCents equals TotalCents / Count, truncated to whole cents. Periods with zero payouts keep returning ErrNoPayouts (unchanged).

context_slices.note: Repository search: newSummary is called only from Daily and Monthly; averageCents only from newSummary.
